name: ATC_PRODOFFER_ELIGIBILITIES
description: Stores details of product offer eligibilities

columns.name: RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies whether the offer is eligible or not on satisfying the conditions

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies if the rule is active or not

columns.name: CONIDITION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies if there are conditions for the offer to be eligible or is always true

columns.name: CONDITION_ATTR
columns.description: Provides the set of conditions which determine the products which will be eligible.

columns.name: ORDER_OF_OPERATION
columns.description: Provides the order of execution of the conditions

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Indicates the product offer to which the eligibility is associated to

columns.name: ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Indicates the entity name to which the rule is associated to

columns.name: START_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Start time from which the eligibility is valid

columns.name: END_DATE_TIME
columns.description: End Time to which the eligibility is valid

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
